* Safe localStorage wrapper for Safari compatibility\n * \n * Safari (especially in private browsing or with ITP) can:\n * - Block localStorage access\n * - Throw QuotaExceededError\n * - Return null silently\n * \n * This wrapper ensures the app doesn't crash or hang\n */\n\nconst isStorageAvailable = () => {\n  try {\n    const test = '__storage_test__';\n    localStorage.setItem(test, test);\n    localStorage.removeItem(test);\n    return true;\n  } catch (e) {\n    return false;\n  }\n};\n\nexport const safeLocalStorage = {\n  getItem: (key, defaultValue = null) => {\n    try {\n      if (!isStorageAvailable()) {\n        console.warn('[SafeStorage] localStorage not available, using fallback');\n        return defaultValue;\n      }\n      const item = localStorage.getItem(key);\n      return item !== null ? item : defaultValue;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(`[SafeStorage] Failed to get ${key}:`, error.message);\n      return defaultValue;\n    }\n  },\n\n  setItem: (key, value) => {\n    try {\n      if (!isStorageAvailable()) {\n        console.warn('[SafeStorage] localStorage not available, cannot save');\n        return false;\n      }\n      localStorage.setItem(key, value);\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(`[SafeStorage] Failed to set ${key}:`, error.message);\n      return false;\n    }\n  },\n\n  removeItem: (key) => {\n    try {\n      if (!isStorageAvailable()) {\n        return false;\n      }\n      localStorage.removeItem(key);\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(`[SafeStorage] Failed to remove ${key}:`, error.message);\n      return false;\n    }\n  },\n\n  clear: () => {\n    try {\n      if (!isStorageAvailable()) {\n        return false;\n      }\n      localStorage.clear();\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('[SafeStorage] Failed to clear:', error.message);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n};\n\nexport default \"*\" / \"+\" / \"-\" / \".\" / \"^\" / \"_\" /\n *                     \"`\" / \"|\" / \"~\" / DIGIT / ALPHA\n *\n * Note: Allowing more characters - https://github.com/jshttp/cookie/issues/191\n * <let-dig>         = <letter> | <digit>\n * <letter>          = any one of the 52 alphabetic characters A through Z in\n *                     upper case and a through z in lower case\n * <digit> It takes in a list of items,\n * the search and the current item, and returns the next item (or `undefined`).\n *\n * We normalize the search because if a user has repeatedly pressed a character,\n * we want the exact same behavior as if we only had that one character\n * (ie. cycle through items starting with that character)\n *\n * We also reorder the items by wrapping the array around the current item.\n * This is so we always look forward from the current item, and picking the first\n * item will always be the correct one.\n *\n * Finally, if the normalized search is exactly one character, we exclude the\n * current item from the values because otherwise it would be the first to match always\n * and focus would never move. (annualCashFlow / cashInvested) * 100 : 0;\n      \n      // DSCR calculation\n      const annualDebtService = monthlyMortgage * 12;\n      const dscr = annualDebtService > 0 ? noi / annualDebtService : 0;\n      \n      // Break-even occupancy\n      const potentialGrossIncome = annualGrossIncome;\n      const breakEvenOccupancy = potentialGrossIncome > 0 ? \n        ((operatingExpenses + annualDebtService) / potentialGrossIncome) * 100 : 0;\n      \n      // 5-year IRR calculation (simplified)\n      const futureValue = purchasePrice * Math.pow(1 + appreciationRate / 100, 5);\n      const exitNOI = noi * Math.pow(1 + appreciationRate / 100, 5);\n      const exitValue = exitNOI / (exitCapRate / 100);\n      const totalCashFlows = annualCashFlow * 5;\n      const totalReturn = (exitValue + totalCashFlows - purchasePrice) / purchasePrice * 100;\n      \n      // Simplified IRR calculation (this is a rough approximation)\n      const irr = Math.pow((exitValue + totalCashFlows) / cashInvested, 1/5) - 1;\n      const irrPercent = irr * 100;\n      \n      // MOIC calculation\n      const moic = cashInvested > 0 ? (exitValue + totalCashFlows) / cashInvested : 0;\n      \n      // Rent-to-price ratio\n      const rentToPriceRatio = purchasePrice > 0 ? (monthlyRent / purchasePrice) * 100 : 0;\n\n      const calculatedMetrics = {\n        // Property Info\n        purchasePrice: purchasePrice,\n        monthlyRent: monthlyRent,\n        \n        // Income & Expenses\n        effectiveGrossIncome: effectiveGrossIncome,\n        operatingExpenses: operatingExpenses,\n        noi: noi,\n        monthlyCashFlow: monthlyCashFlow,\n        annualCashFlow: annualCashFlow,\n        \n        // Key Ratios\n        capRate: capRate,\n        cashOnCash: cashOnCash,\n        dscr: dscr,\n        rentToPriceRatio: rentToPriceRatio,\n        breakEvenOccupancy: breakEvenOccupancy,\n        \n        // Investment Analysis\n        irrPercent: irrPercent,\n        moic: moic,\n        totalReturn: totalReturn,\n        \n        // Additional Info\n        cashInvested: cashInvested,\n        monthlyMortgage: monthlyMortgage,\n        exitValue: exitValue\n      };\n\n      setMetrics(calculatedMetrics);\n      toast.success('Calculations completed successfully!');\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Calculation error:', error);\n      toast.error('Error calculating metrics. Please check your inputs.');\n    } finally {\n      setIsCalculating(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Auto-calculate when key fields change\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const hasMinimumData = propertyData.interestRate]);\n\n  // Handle PDF preview and download using new golden template\n  const handleDownloadPDF = async () => {\n    if (!metrics) {\n      toast.error('Please calculate \n      // Get filename from response headers or generate one\n      const disposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition');\n      let filename = 'investor_analysis.pdf';\n      if function handleFocusOut(event: FocusEvent) {\n        if (focusScope.paused || !container) return;\n        const relatedTarget = event.relatedTarget as HTMLElement | null;\n\n        // A `focusout` This cannot be worked out easily by just reading a property, but rather\n * necessitate runtime knowledge (computed styles, etc).  }\n      \n      // Step 1: Calculate GCI (Gross Commission Income)\n      const gci = salePrice * (totalCommission / 100);\n      \n      // Step 2: Determine your side share\n      let
